name: Twenty
one_liner: Twenty is an open-source CRM (self-hostable or cloud-hosted) offering REST and GraphQL APIs for records and workspace schema management.

evidence.quote: Create an API key in Settings → API & Webhooks → + Create key. Copy it immediately — it's shown once.
Start your free trial today without credit card.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Twenty CRM integration. Enables natural language interactions with your CRM data through Claude and other AI assistants.
For OAuth-based access (external apps acting on behalf of users), see [OAuth](/developers/extend/oauth).
Self-host the open source core for free, or upgrade to Organization for SSO and row-level permissions.
Core API (/rest/ and /graphql/) — Handles CRUD operations on records like People, Companies, and custom objects
Unauthenticated probe -> HTTP 403; WWW-Authenticate: None; body: {"statusCode":403,"messages":["Missing authentication token"],"error":"FORBIDDEN_EXCEPTION"}

notes: Twenty is open-source and self-hostable (Docker Compose) for free with unrestricted REST/GraphQL API access via API key (bearer token) — this is the most accessible self-serve path. The managed cloud offering has a no-credit-card free trial, then requires a paid plan (Pro $9/user/mo+) for API access; endpoint count is not fixed since the API is dynamically generated per workspace schema. OAuth2 is documented for third-party apps acting on behalf of users. No official vendor MCP server found; several community MCP servers exist (github.com/mhenry3164, igorwarzocha, jezweb) and an open GitHub issue (twentyhq/twenty#12953) requesting an official one.
